Make the two drawn rooms as dense as the prints: redraw Kitchen and Bedrooms as full room scenes in the porch-break line style (cabinets, window, bed, lamp, the dust being worked) filling the taped sheet, and at 390 reframe the porch break to a tight crop on the pollen-dusted rail and rocking chair instead of the door.
